t: Сапфир дома Романовых весом почти 200 карат выставят на торги

te: Romanov house suffir weighing almost 200 carats will be put up for auction
de: Cartier bracelet with sapphire from the collection of the Russian Imperial House of Romanov will be put up for auction in Geneva. This was reported by the auction house Sotheby’s on its website. The 197.8-carat stone adorns a platinum diamond bracelet. Lot…
